Sarcoidosis: non-necrotizing granulomas composed of epithelioid histiocytes, Langhans giant cells and lymphocytes

top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: The patient's symptoms and biopsy results, including non-necrotizing granulomas and epithelioid histiocytes, are consistent with Sarcoidosis. The presence of mediastinal lymphadenopathy, splenomegaly, and hilar adenopathy also support this diagnosis.
